issues.description: Method: singFarmSong(). Problem statement and UML describe singFarmSong() as a void method that prints the song (the task text: "Implement the method singFarmSong() ... which prints the Old MacDonald had a Farm song"). The template Farm.java declares public void singFarmSong() (signature at template). The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) declares public String singFarmSong() returning the assembled song text. This mismatch (void vs String) creates confusion about whether students should implement printing side-effects or return the song text, and which signature their code must use to match the exercise and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to match the problem/template by making singFarmSong() have signature public void singFarmSong() and perform printing, or (B) update the problem statement/UML and the template to specify public String singFarmSong() and document that it returns the full song text. Choose one approach and apply it to the UML, problem text, template signature, and solution code so students have a single, unambiguous expectation.

issues.description: Method: singFarmSongVerse(Animal). The UML in the problem statement and the template Farm.java show a private helper that prints a verse (implying a void helper). The template defines private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/) (signature in template). The solution implements private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) that returns the verse as a String. This inconsistency affects whether the helper should produce side effects (print) or assemble and return text, and therefore how students are expected to structure singFarmSong() (print vs. concatenate).
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a consistent design for the helper across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to be private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) and have it print the verse (matching the UML/template and the "prints the song" requirement), or (B) update the UML and template to indicate the helper returns a String and adjust the template signature and task description to document returning assembled verse text. Apply the same convention to singFarmSong() so the public API and private helpers are coherent.
